Pricing hero title: Run one greenhouse irrigation setup for free
Pricing hero description: Home Aidvor helps you connect controllers, monitor telemetry, control relays and run automation scenes. The free plan is not a demo: it can manage one real setup, for example a single greenhouse irrigation system. Paid plans are useful when you add more devices, longer history, notifications and multiple sites.

Integrator description: If you build solutions for customers, the platform gives you a practical base: roles, API and tariff-based scaling.
FAQ q1: Can I start on Free and upgrade later?
FAQ a1: Yes. You can start with Free and switch to a paid plan anytime. After payment, limits are applied automatically.
FAQ q2: What happens when a paid plan expires?
FAQ a2: The selected plan remains in the profile, but FREE limits are applied until renewal.
